title: Market Street

film_notes.text: The dead were counted at 478 by the city in 1907 and 498 by the Army in 1906. Research since names more than 3,000.
film_notes.source: 498: the Army's report, Maj. Gen. Adolphus W. Greely, Earthquake in California, April 18, 1906 (1906), page 15: 304 known and 194 unknown in San Francisco. 478: the city's count of 1907. More than 3,000: Gladys Hansen and Emmet Condon, Denial of Disaster (1989).
